name: Floareá Skies
highlights: 192 homes in a tower of four podium levels and 19 residential floors
Studios, one-bedroom and two-bedroom apartments, several with a study
Direct access to Al Khail Road
Also sold on a 1% monthly plan or a 30/35/35 plan that runs after handover
Mashriq Elite handed over Floareá Residence in Arjan in August 2025
description: Floareá Skies is a 192-apartment tower in Jumeirah Village Circle with direct access to Al Khail Road. Homes run from 398 sq ft studios to two-bedroom apartments with a study, spread over 19 residential floors above four podium levels.

The amenities sit at the top and at podium level: an infinity pool on the roof, an organic pool for children, a Japanese garden with mini golf and a floating meditation deck. Payments follow a 30/70 plan, with 1% monthly and post-handover options.

name: Floareá Oasis
highlights: Studios, one-bedroom apartments with a study, and two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room
Family amenities on the podium and the roof
Also sold on a 1% monthly plan or a 30/35/35 plan that runs after handover
Mashriq Elite handed over Floareá Residence in Arjan in August 2025
description: Floareá Oasis is a 257-apartment building in the Dubai Land Residence Complex, with studios from 425 sq ft, one-bedroom apartments with a study and two-bedroom apartments with a maid's room, over 13 residential floors.

It is planned around families: a pool and splash pad, a children's play area, an outdoor gym and barbecue stations, with a fully equipped gym inside. Payments follow a 30/70 plan, with 1% monthly and post-handover options.

name: Floareá Breeze
highlights: A boutique building of 48 apartments and 4 townhouses
One, two and three-bedroom apartments, and three-bedroom townhouses facing the park
Five minutes' walk from the marina, the mall and the beach
Also sold on a 30/35/35 plan that runs after handover
Mashriq Elite handed over Floareá Residence in Arjan in August 2025
description: Floareá Breeze is a boutique building on Dubai Islands with 48 apartments and 4 park-facing townhouses. Apartments have one to three bedrooms, from 878 sq ft; the three-bedroom townhouses run to about 1,900 sq ft.

The marina, the mall and the beach are about five minutes away on foot. The building has a pool and a children's pool, an indoor gym, a play area and a board game nook. Payments follow a 30/70 plan, with a post-handover option.
